### 2026-11-01: I'm creating an LED weather display, this will show time, weather and the date. Month and day. It a simple but it will just be sitting on my desk. So I created a version 1 that has the very minimal id

**3h**

I'm creating an LED weather display, this will show time, weather and the date. Month and day. It a simple but it will just be sitting on my desk. So I created a version 1 that has the very minimal idea of it as you can see, it really just shows the shape of it.
